description: Simulates an operational environment where single-factor password authentication is used without secondary verification.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Email / Web Communication
conceptual_attack_path.description: User encounters a simulated deceptive communication or phishing link.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Single-Factor Credential Access
conceptual_attack_path.description: Account credentials are exposed without secondary MFA protection.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Internal System Navigation
conceptual_attack_path.description: Exposed account permissions allow access to internal corporate services.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Potential Data Availability Loss
conceptual_attack_path.description: System access exposes operational data stores to potential availability risks.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Operational Interruption
conceptual_attack_path.description: Account lockout and potential disruption to user business activities.

recommended_remediation: Mandate FIDO2/Hardware MFA or Authenticator App push notifications across all user accounts.
Enforce step-up authentication for access to sensitive financial and operational portals.
Disable legacy password-only authentication protocols across the organization.

description: Simulates a scenario where backups are maintained online without air-gapping or immutable write locks.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Initial System Entry
conceptual_attack_path.description: A simulated perimeter vulnerability permits initial system entry.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Administrative Permission Exposure
conceptual_attack_path.description: Local administrative accounts are accessed without privilege boundary controls.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Storage Network Access
conceptual_attack_path.description: Network access extends to online backup repositories.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Backup & Primary Data Lock Risk
conceptual_attack_path.description: Online backups and primary file stores face simultaneous data availability risk.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Severe Operational Shutdown
conceptual_attack_path.description: Prolonged business downtime due to lack of uncompromised recovery points.

recommended_remediation: Maintain air-gapped, offline, or immutable backups following the 3-2-1 backup strategy.
Implement write-once-read-many (WORM) storage policies for core system backups.
Conduct quarterly backup restoration drills to verify recovery point and time objectives.

description: Simulates endpoints lacking centralized behavioral monitoring or EDR agent telemetry.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Untrusted Binary Execution
conceptual_attack_path.description: An untrusted executable file is launched on an unmonitored workstation.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Local User Rights Abuse
conceptual_attack_path.description: Local user privileges are utilized without endpoint behavioral alerts.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Unmonitored Workstation Surfing
conceptual_attack_path.description: Absence of EDR alerts allows undetected navigation between adjacent workstations.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Unchecked Mass Encryption Risk
conceptual_attack_path.description: Process execution continues without automated endpoint isolation triggers.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Multi-Endpoint Operational Impact
conceptual_attack_path.description: Multiple staff endpoints require manual forensic clean-up and re-imaging.

recommended_remediation: Deploy centralized EDR agents with 24/7 telemetry across 100% of corporate endpoints.
Enable automated device isolation rules for suspicious process behaviors.
Audit endpoint coverage weekly to ensure no newly provisioned devices lack EDR protection.

description: Simulates delayed patch management where known critical CVEs remain unpatched past 30 days.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Exposed Public Port Scanning
conceptual_attack_path.description: Simulated internet scans identify an unpatched public-facing service.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Public Service Privilege Access
conceptual_attack_path.description: Known software vulnerabilities allow unauthorized service privilege access.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Internal Infrastructure Entry
conceptual_attack_path.description: Compromised service grants initial foothold into internal network segments.

conceptual_attack_path.title: System Service Encryption Risk
conceptual_attack_path.description: Internal server infrastructure faces potential software encryption risks.

conceptual_attack_path.title: External Service Interruption
conceptual_attack_path.description: Customer-facing web applications and internal portals experience downtime.

recommended_remediation: Enforce a strict 48-to-72-hour patch management SLA for critical security vulnerabilities.
Implement automated vulnerability scanning across all public IP addresses and internal subnets.
Decommission or isolate legacy operating systems unable to receive vendor security updates.

security_control_affected: Principle of Least Privilege & PAM Controls
description: Simulates standard user accounts operating with permanent local administrative rights.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Standard User Session Entry
conceptual_attack_path.description: A standard employee workstation session is established.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Immediate Admin Right Access
conceptual_attack_path.description: User account possesses broad local administrator rights without escalation checks.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Broad Domain Privilege Expansion
conceptual_attack_path.description: Over-privileged credentials permit unrestricted access across administrative shares.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Domain-Wide Availability Risk
conceptual_attack_path.description: Administrative authority increases potential scope of data encryption risks.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Domain-Level Operational Outage
conceptual_attack_path.description: Broad domain permissions escalate operational outage severity.

recommended_remediation: Remove permanent local admin rights from standard employee laptops and workstations.
Implement Privileged Access Management (PAM) with temporary Just-In-Time approval workflows.
Audit active directory group memberships monthly to enforce strict role-based access control.

description: Simulates workforce lacking regular cybersecurity training or phishing awareness drills.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Social Engineering Interaction
conceptual_attack_path.description: An employee receives a simulated social engineering or deceptive message.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Unintentional Information Sharing
conceptual_attack_path.description: Lack of training results in unintentional sharing of corporate login details.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Internal Communication Abuse
conceptual_attack_path.description: Compromised employee email account sends internal deceptive messages to peers.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Unreported Threat Activity
conceptual_attack_path.description: Threat activity goes unreported due to lack of security reporting awareness.

conceptual_attack_path.title: Organization-Wide Email Distrust
conceptual_attack_path.description: Loss of email communication trust and productivity disruption.

recommended_remediation: Conduct mandatory quarterly security awareness training for all organizational staff.
Execute monthly simulated phishing drills with immediate feedback for repeat clickers.
Deploy a one-click phishing report button in email clients to encourage active threat reporting.
